name: SEBI

description: SEBI (Stylus Execution Boundary Inspector) is a deterministic static analysis engine for Stylus-compiled WASM smart contracts. It inspects WebAssembly binaries before deployment to detect execution-boundary risks — unbounded memory growth, dynamic dispatch via call_indirect, loop constructs, and oversized artifacts — without executing the contract or relying on chain state. Reports are stable, reproducible JSON with CI-gating exit codes.
stylusUsage: Parses Stylus-compiled WASM binaries to extract structural signals (memory bounds, instruction patterns, import/export surfaces) and evaluates them against a rule catalog tuned for Stylus execution-boundary risks, producing deterministic JSON safety reports.
